import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('~/Documents/GitHub/gaia-agent/runs/practice_files/p03-csv-evening-trips/shuttle_trips.csv')

# Convert to datetime
df['departure'] = pd.to_datetime(df['departure'])
df['arrival'] = pd.to_datetime(df['arrival'])

# Filter for trips departing at or after 18:00
df['departure_hour'] = df['departure'].dt.hour
evening_trips = df[df['departure_hour'] >= 18]

print(f"Total trips: {len(df)}")
print(f"Evening trips (departure >= 18:00): {len(evening_trips)}")

# Calculate duration in minutes
evening_trips = evening_trips.copy()
evening_trips['duration_minutes'] = (evening_trips['arrival'] - evening_trips['departure']).dt.total_seconds() / 60

print("\nEvening trips with durations:")
print(evening_trips[['trip_id', 'route', 'departure', 'arrival', 'duration_minutes']])

# Filter for trips longer than 90 minutes
long_trips = evening_trips[evening_trips['duration_minutes'] > 90]
print(f"\nTrips longer than 90 minutes: {len(long_trips)}")
print(long_trips[['trip_id', 'route', 'departure', 'arrival', 'duration_minutes']])
